# log entry URL

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:logEntryUrl`](gmeow-logEntryUrl.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/logEntryUrl>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/attestation`](../../slices/attestation.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A URL at which the transparency log entry can be retrieved. Non-functional: multiple mirrors may exist.

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:TransparencyLogEntry`](../classes/gmeow-TransparencyLogEntry.md) -> [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record a retrieval URL for a [`gmeow:TransparencyLogEntry`](../classes/gmeow-TransparencyLogEntry.md) so a consumer can fetch and re-check the logged record; assert one per mirror.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the entry's position within the log (that is [`gmeow:logEntryIndex`](gmeow-logEntryIndex.md)) and avoid treating it as a single canonical location — multiple mirrors may exist, so it is non-functional.

### How to use

- Attach one URL literal per mirror on the [`gmeow:TransparencyLogEntry`](../classes/gmeow-TransparencyLogEntry.md); pair with [`gmeow:logEntryIndex`](gmeow-logEntryIndex.md) for stable identity independent of any one mirror's availability.

### Examples

- ex:rekorEntry [`gmeow:logEntryUrl`](gmeow-logEntryUrl.md) "https://rekor.sigstore.dev/api/v1/log/entries/...".
